periods.time: Final day of the Vermillion-Quedland war and immediate hospital aftermath
periods.label: 以剑神之名赴死又归来的落第骑士
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Vermillion representative team; Kurogane family

status.current: revived by Shizuku and recovering in a child-sized temporary body in a Vermillion hospital
status.condition: alive but physically diminished; about thirty percent of adult body mass still under repair; emotionally shaken by death and by having hurt Stella
status.goal: recover, keep his promise to Stella, and grow strong enough never to force the same sacrifice again

personality.summary: Gentle, analytical and almost terrifyingly victory-focused, yet forced to confront that love makes self-sacrifice wound those left behind.
fears: being too weak to save everyone without dying

relationships.stella-vermillion: Fiancee and partner; he trusts her to win after his death, but later accepts that choosing death betrayed the promise to stay beside her.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Sister and savior; she reconstructs his destroyed body with Water World and temporarily shares her cells with him.
relationships.alice-ascaride: Former ally and opponent; he kills her with Oikage, refuses to forget her, and carries her pain in his sword.
relationships.or-gaule: Final enemy; he cannot kill Or-Gaule alone after Danse Macabre but sets up Kuruizakura cuts so Stella can finish him.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Teacher and rear guard; he thanks her for prioritizing civilian defense while letting him attack.
relationships.levi-ascaride: Receives a promise of one personal favor through Nene after killing Levi's adopted daughter Alice.

periods.summary: Ikki first appears apparently dying after Or-Gaule's final attack, then the volume reveals how that moment was reached. He takes over the fight against Alice Ascaride so Stella can pursue Or-Gaule. Against Alice's Invincible Armor and Regeneration Overdose, he initially cannot damage her, but he reads both her fighting patterns and her need to save Or-Gaule. By trusting Stella to corner Or-Gaule, he forces Alice to abandon the safe long battle and accept a short decisive clash. Using Ittou Rasetsu and the final secret sword Oikage, he cuts through Invincible Armor, defeats Alice, and holds her as she dies, promising never to forget the gentle knight who fought for family. The battle earns him the new name Sword God. After briefly recovering via autophagy, Ikki intervenes when Or-Gaule's corpse uses Danse Macabre to strangle Stella. Ikki duels the undead Or-Gaule for one minute with no magic and a collapsing body, publicly declares that he will die to buy Stella the chance to recover, and secretly plants delayed Kuruizakura cuts. Or-Gaule tears open his chest and kills him, but those cuts later disrupt La Grand Guignol, allowing Stella to burn Or-Gaule to ash. Shizuku then uses Water World to rebuild Ikki from cells and temporarily replaces missing tissue with her own. Ikki awakens in hospital three days later in a child-sized body, learns of Shizuku's promotion and his own new political weight, and reconciles with Stella after accepting that planning to die was a betrayal of their love.

key_events.summary: Defeats Alice Ascaride by turning her urgency into the opening for Oikage.
Fights Or-Gaule's corpse for one minute, plants Kuruizakura cuts, and is killed protecting Stella's recovery window.
His delayed cuts enable Stella's victory while Shizuku reconstructs his corpse.
Wakes in hospital, learns the cost of revival, and reconciles with Stella.
